test.create_query: CREATE TABLE cosine_distance_const (bf16 Array(BFloat16), f32 Array(Float32)) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO cosine_distance_const SELECT CAST(v AS Array(BFloat16)), CAST(v AS Array(Float32)) FROM (SELECT arrayMap(i -> sin(number * 0.001 + i * 0.37), range(768)) AS v FROM numbers(600000))
test.query: SELECT sum(cosineDistance(bf16, arrayMap(i -> cos(i), range(768)))) FROM cosine_distance_const
SELECT sum(cosineDistance(bf16, CAST(arrayMap(i -> cos(i), range(768)) AS Array(BFloat16)))) FROM cosine_distance_const
SELECT sum(cosineDistance(f32, arrayMap(i -> cos(i), range(768)))) FROM cosine_distance_const
